name: Biomechanics
summary: Mechanics applied to the human body: tissue mechanics, muscles and joints, human movement analysis and musculoskeletal modelling.

topics.name: Musculoskeletal anatomy and terminology for engineers
Mechanics of biological tissues: bone, cartilage, ligament and tendon
Muscle mechanics: Hill model, force-length and force-velocity relations
Joint mechanics: hip, knee, ankle, shoulder and spine
Human gait and movement: gait phases, ground reaction forces and joint moments
Motion capture, force plates, IMUs and EMG measurement
Injury biomechanics and human tolerance limits
Sports and occupational biomechanics; ergonomics of lifting
